description: A nonempty expanded structure satisfies the five equality schemes if and only if every native formula of a clause in \(\mathcal E_L\) holds under every natural-number-variable assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.axioms_iff_clauses.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {N : Type z}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N] [Nonempty N] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N ↔
    ∀ C ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.axiomClauses L,
      ∀ (v : ℕ → N), (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseToFormula C).Realize v
